blurb: Center Stage Dance & Tumbling offers dance classes including a Performing Company for dancers who want to perform regularly beyond the annual recital. The Performing Company performs monthly from January to June at various venues and includes a group for special needs dancers. Special needs classes are available for kids ages 2 and up and adults, adapted to individual needs with supportive teachers and peer helpers.
